objective: Normalized training-only mutual_info_regression relevance minus mean absolute-Pearson redundancy plus cardinality penalty; use continuous log1p/yearly mean target, never a binary fire label
predictor: fixed Ridge alpha=1 with train-only median/StandardScaler and log1p/training-standardized outcome
sqd: Apply addon sampled_subspace to the same sampled feasible bitstrings; verify projected minimum equals best sampled diagonal-QUBO energy; not a new predictor or quantum gain
fairness: Selectors see the same outer-training years; predictor and four-feature count fixed. All-ten is an explicit different input budget. Seeds are sensitivity runs over the same years.
rejection: No promotion from better surrogate energy alone; compare hectare errors, objective gap, subset overlap and elapsed cost. Failed feasible draws remain failed; no exact-solver fallback.
